content:
I've searched through Nobel Prize winners and couldn't find any whose first and last names actually rhyme with each other.

This is quite rare because it would require someone to have names like "Ben Chen" or "Paul Saul" - and even then, those would need to be their official names at the time of winning the prize.

Some Nobel laureates have had alliterative names (same starting letter) like:
- Herbert Hauptmann (Chemistry, 1985)
- Woodrow Wilson (Peace, 1919)

But true rhyming first and last names don't appear in the Nobel Prize records I can recall.

If you're aware of one I've missed, I'd be interested to hear it!
